scope: Chamagnieu V18 furniture pilot research only; no asset binary downloaded or integrated.

license_policy.accepted: Only assets reported free, downloadable, and CC0 by the official source API, with an anonymous metadata/direct-file HTTP probe.
license_policy.blendkit_cc0: Accepted for open Web embedding under the official CC0 documentation and 2026 terms.
license_policy.blendkit_royalty_free: Rejected for this viewer because official 2026 terms prohibit embedding an open-format 3D model under Royalty Free.
license_policy.third_party_product_rights: Uploader CC0 does not clear separate product-design or trademark rights; branded/fan-made replicas are MANUAL_IP_REVIEW_REQUIRED.
license_policy.attribution: CC0 attribution is not required, but author/source/license records are retained.

research_limits: No 3D binary payload was fetched in this research phase.
Scores are metadata- and thumbnail-informed screening scores; geometry, UVs, materials and visual fit still require import/visual QA before final integration.
Sketchfab and Fab were not needed for the minimum candidate count and no candidate from them was counted without a validated accountless download path.
